'''Sorel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Sorel served as the [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Gamble]]'' during a mission to acquire supplies for the construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
